text: Build step 5 of the build order in docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 12: the Jev client and a fake that follows the real response shape, used only in shadow (it never decides). Facts from live probes through the gateway today (2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14; the operator ran them, agents may not reach the network): POST https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/evaluate with body {model: 'typesafe-ai/jev', state: <text>, questions: {<key>: {type: 'choice', instructions, criteria: {<option>: <description>}} or {type: 'boolean', instructions}}}. Several questions in one call work. A choice answer is {type: 'choice', choice, probabilities: {<option>: p}, confidence}; a boolean answer is {type: 'boolean', probability} (the probability of true, with no value field). The response has usage {inputTokens, outputTokens} and providerMetadata.gateway.cost as a decimal string (about /bin/bash.00002 a call). /v1/chat/completions refuses Jev as 'a decision model, not a language model'; treat that as a build error, not a retry. In this environment a proxy authenticates calls to *.vercel.sh; elsewhere the key comes from the AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY environment variable and is never written to files, records or output. Use the existing retrying outbound wrapper. Ask Jev the two introspection questions (failure class, and whether it is a repeat) in shadow next to the existing classification, and record both answers so they can be scored later. Live tests are opt-in, as for the other models.
